name: API error rate high
query: 100 * (count of HTTP server spans with status_code >= 500) / (count of all HTTP server spans), over a trailing 5-minute window, across all tenant schemas.
notes: Backed by logfire.instrument_fastapi() auto-instrumentation; no custom metric exists for this. Mirrors the Platform Overview dashboard's 5xx error rate panel (infra/observability/logfire/dashboards/platform-overview.json). Apply a minimum-request-count guard (e.g. total spans >= 20 in the window) when wiring this up in the Logfire UI/MCP so a single 5xx on near-zero traffic doesn't read as a 100% error rate.
